descriptionChirho: Gentilic adjective/noun denoting a descendant or member of the clan of Kohath, son of Levi; used both in singular (the Kohathite) and plural (the Kohathites) forms. Eng 'the Kohathite(s),' Spa 'el coatita / los coatitas,' Hin 'कहाती,' Arb 'الْقَهَاتِيّ / الْقَهَاتِيِّينَ,' Kor '고핫인,' Swa 'Wakohathi.' The singular and plural inflections refer to the same clan identity and do not constitute distinct senses.
